title: Excessive Error Disclosure - Stack Trace Exposure in 404 Errors
description: The vulnerable error handler exposes stack traces in 404 Not Found responses. When a resource is not found, the notFoundHandler middleware creates an AppError with code NOT_FOUND, which is then processed by the vulnerableErrorHandler. The vulnerable error handler includes the full stack trace in the response body under error.stack, exposing internal code structure, file paths, and call stacks for 404 errors.
impact: Information disclosure aiding reconnaissance. Attackers can enumerate valid endpoints by probing for 404s and collecting stack traces that reveal internal code structure, file paths, and call chains. This information aids in crafting more targeted attacks against other vulnerabilities.
mitigation: 1) Implement secure error handler that returns sanitized 404 responses (code, message only). 2) Ensure notFoundHandler creates AppError without exposing stack traces in production. 3) Configure error handler to suppress stack traces in production environment (NODE_ENV=production). 4) Use secure error handler from api-secure which only returns { code, message } for 404 errors.

history.details: Initial audit finding recorded for stack trace exposure in 404 errors
